cases.short_flags: Add -H, -p, -t, and -w as aliases for --host, --ports, --timeout, and --workers respectively. Preserve long flags, required arguments, defaults and all other behavior.
cases.empty_scan: Make scan_ports return ([], []) immediately for an empty ports sequence, without DNS lookup or constructing a thread pool. Preserve all nonempty behavior.
cases.socket_creation: Make scan_port return False if socket.socket itself raises OSError, as it already does for connection OSError. Preserve successful connections, timeout handling and closing successfully created sockets.
cases.compact_json: Make main emit compact JSON without spaces after separators. Preserve the trailing newline, sorted keys, all existing fields and values, and exit behavior.
cases.default_workers_six: Change build_parser so --workers defaults to 6, preserving explicit overrides, other defaults and all existing behavior.
cases.timeout_upper_guard: In scan_port, reject timeout values greater than 60 with ValueError before creating a socket. Preserve timeout=60, ordinary positive timeout behavior, return values, and socket cleanup. No new imports.
cases.guard_empty_host: In scan_port, reject an empty host string with ValueError before creating any socket. Preserve nonempty host behavior, return values, and cleanup. No new imports.
cases.json_unicode: Make main JSON output retain Unicode host characters rather than escaping them with ASCII unicode escapes. Preserve the existing output fields, sorted keys, trailing newline and all scanner behavior.
cases.json_no_nan: Make main JSON serialization reject NaN/Infinity in results with ValueError instead of emitting nonstandard JSON. Preserve normal JSON fields, sorted keys, trailing newline and scanner behavior.
cases.guard_port_bounds: In scan_port, raise ValueError before creating a socket when port is outside 1..65535 inclusive. Preserve valid boundary ports, normal behavior, return values and cleanup. No new imports.

fallback: At most one native retry from pristine on any protocol/application/test failure
usage: Combined prompt = classifier prefix + injected suffix; completion includes one internal control ID; missing usage is never a zero-cost success
timing: includes API/SSH, applying edits, task tests, and 17 regressions; payload preparation excluded for every arm
scope: Same-project previously tuned regression tasks; not held-out or full agent-loop validation
